title: The Cruel joke at his expense
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：cruel　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cruel 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the director wrote of ① a cruel joke at his expense in the poster, and everybody in the theatre said at once that it was ② crueler than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the director, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the cruel ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the cruelest joke at his expense anybody in the theatre had ever seen, or so the poster for August 1959 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too cruel to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the actor who had come to help; the cruel ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a cruel winter on the moor, and said that no actor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as cruel as the winter on the moor they had once had in the old theatre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was cruel or not, and he said so.

By 1972 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the poster. What the line asked for was ⑦ something cruel, and nothing besides. The actor from the next theatre called the whole plan ⑧ quite cruel; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the poster kept the names of the cruel ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1975, with great care, she wrote of another cruel joke at his expense in the same poster, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ crueler than anybody had expected. ⑩ The cruelest winter on the moor in the whole theatre, she said in 1977, was the one she could never quite name; the cruel ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 残忍（前置定语 a cruel joke at his expense：1965 年导演在戏报里记下的那件残忍的玩笑）
B. adj. 残忍／严酷（比较级 crueler than：文中两处，一处比拿他开涮的玩笑，一处比预想）
C. adj. 残忍／严酷（最高级 the cruelest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 残忍（表语 too cruel to do：母亲觉得它太残忍，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 严酷（前置定语 a cruel winter on the moor：叔叔把整件事称作一桩严酷的冬天）
F. adj. 严酷（同级比较 as cruel as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩荒原上的冬天相比）
G. adj. 严酷（后置定语 something cruel：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 严酷（受程度副词修饰 quite cruel：那位演员的评价）

items.q: a cruel joke at his expense
the cruelest joke at his expense anybody
a cruel winter on the moor
The cruelest winter on the moor in

answers.why: cruel 意为“残忍”，1965 年导演在戏报里记下的是“一件残忍的玩笑”，此处作前置定语 a cruel joke at his expense。
cruel 意为“残忍”，此处用比较级 crueler than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
cruel 意为“残忍”，戏报上 八月 那行字说它是戏院里最残忍的一件，故用最高级 the cruelest joke at his expense。
cruel 意为“残忍”，母亲认为这件东西“太残忍了，谁也用不上”，too cruel to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
cruel 意为“严酷”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩严酷的冬天”，此处作前置定语 a cruel winter on the moor。
cruel 意为“严酷”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩荒原上的冬天一样严酷”，同级比较用 as cruel as。
cruel 意为“严酷”，戏报上那半行字要的是“严酷的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something cruel。
cruel 意为“严酷”，邻戏院来的那位演员认为这套计划“相当严酷”，quite 修饰原级 cruel。
cruel 意为“严酷”，1975 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要严酷”，故用比较级 crueler than。
cruel 意为“严酷”，母亲 1977 年说的是“整个戏院里最严酷的那一桩”，故用最高级 the cruelest winter on the moor。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，导演在戏报里记下了一件残忍的玩笑。（a cruel joke at his expense）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更残忍。（crueler than …）
母亲觉得它太残忍，谁也用不上。（too cruel to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩严酷的冬天。（a cruel winter on the moor）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩荒原上的冬天一样严酷。（as cruel as …）
到了 1972 年，戏报上只剩半行字：要的是一件严酷的东西。（something cruel）
answers: In 1965 the director wrote of a cruel joke at his expense in the poster.
Everybody said it was crueler than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too cruel to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a cruel winter on the moor.
He said nobody would call it as cruel as the winter on the moor they had once had.
By 1972 the poster asked for nothing but something cruel.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 cruel 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the director wrote of a cruel joke at his expense in the poster, and nobody forgot it.
It was the cruelest joke at his expense in the theatre, or so the poster says.
My mother thought it too cruel to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a cruel winter on the moor, and nobody argued with him.
The actor from the next theatre called the plan quite cruel, and everybody laughed.
The cruel ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
